sources.title: Fastned - Polestar 2 78 kWh (2020-2023) charge graph
sources.notes: Charge graph data embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (150+ kW charger class); per-percent values 7-93 %. Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C. Page carries no reuse terms; terms-of-use page not readable (404). Same graph data is on the Fastned Volvo XC40 Recharge 78 kWh (2020-2023) and C40 Recharge 78 kWh pages.

curves.notes: Fastned graph for the 78 kWh / 400 V NMC Polestar 2 (2020-2023), 150+ kW charger class, battery assumed near 30 C. Values are stepped (whole kW), which suggests an averaged or smoothed series. Peak about 151 kW held 9-17 %, then steps down to 60 kW at 80 %. The 2023-24 cars (155 kW rating) and the 2024 dual (still 78 kWh) are assumed to share it: Fastned dates it 2020-2023 only. Early software (2020-21) charged slower per InsideEVs and Nyland (99-133 kW peak before OTA); this is the post-update curve. Second-source check: the InsideEVs/Teslarati OTA test (150 kW to about 35 %, about 70 kW near 75-80 %) agrees in rough shape. Same graph on the Fastned XC40 78 kWh page.

Peak 206.8 kW at 12 %, about 127 kW at 50 %, drops to 60 kW at 73 % and 44 kW at 80 %. MEASURED ON THE POLESTAR 2, not the Volvo: Fastned has no graph for the Volvo EX40/XC40 82 kWh (empty chargeGraph), so the curve is borrowed from the Polestar 2 82 kWh pack that the spec batch treats as the same 82 kWh / 400 V / 200-205 kW hardware. Volvo may use different software limits; replace when an EX40 test is found.

Fastned graph for the EX30 69 kWh (2024+), 300 kW charger class, battery assumed near 30 C, 10-89 % only (no data outside that range). Peak 158.7 kW at 29 %, about 101 kW at 50 %, 61 kW at 80 %. Peak is 3.7 % above the 153 kW rating. Identical graph on the Fastned EX30 Cross Country page. Rough second-source check: the InsideEVs 2025 US EX30 test (about 150 kW at 8 %, 130 kW at 30 %, 120 kW at 40 %, 67 kW at 70 %, 45 kW at 80 %, cold start at 3 % SoC) has the same overall shape but is lower after 40 %; six points, not used as a curve.
